hypotheses.justification:
The proof uses `hh1` only through `flattening_contDiffAt`, which needs it to get smoothness and positivity of `q h` from `coordinateQ_spec` and `coordinateQ_smooth`. Those lemmas need `0 < 2*h < 1`. `physicalHeat_contDiffAt` only needs `1 < 1 + h`, which comes from `hh`, and the `sqrt (2 * p.2.1)` factor does not involve `h`.

The case `h ≥ 1/2` is easy because of the definitions. `SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ a p` is defined as `if 0 < a ∧ a < 1 ∧ 0 < p.1 then Classical.choose … else 1`. When `2*h ≥ 1` the condition fails at every point, so `SimilarityProfile.q h = fun _ => 1`. Then `X h p' = p'.2.1 / 1 = p'.2.1` and `flattening h f = fun p' => f (Real.log p'.2.1)`.

Fix a point `p` with `0 < p.2.1` (from `hs`). There `Real.log ∘ (·.2.1)` is smooth: use `contDiffAt_snd.fst.log` with `p.2.1 ≠ 0`. The hypothesis `hf` is now `ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (Real.log p.2.1)`, so `hf.comp` gives `ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (flattening h f) p`. The rest of the proof is unchanged: the product with `physicalHeat`, then division by the nonvanishing `sqrt`.

So the proof splits on `h < 1/2`. In that case run the existing proof. Otherwise rewrite `q h` to the constant 1 by unfolding `coordinateQ` (`dif_neg`) and argue as above. The statement stays true and provable without `hh1`.
